explanation: Secure vault ransomware detection -- originally documented via a real product QA test spec (2026-08-27) as its own mechanism inside secOpsScript_78, setting alertlog.xml's SV_Ransom_current_status/SV_Ransom_detect_time. CONTRADICTED BY REAL SOURCE (2026-08-28): reading the actual, current /athinio/bin/secOpsScript_78 in full shows no such tags anywhere in it. The closest real logic is its ransomcheck() function, which does compare /LinGuard/home_data against each configured param_cmd_78.xml destination via rChecker on a file-content basis -- but that function only LOGS its result ('Alert : Ransomeware corruption Found in $des' / 'INFO : Ransomeware corruption NOT Found in $des' to rationalclient.log and osstatus.log) and never sets any XML tag from its own outcome. The one file it writes to (/athinio/system/rcheckOutput, via append) is never truncated at the start of a run anywhere in the script, so a 'Ransomware corruption FOund' string could persist in it indefinitely from any past run -- using that file as a fresh evidence source would risk reporting a stale historical finding as current. Either the QA doc describes an older/different version of this script than what's actually deployed now, or SV_Ransom_current_status is set by some other component not present in this bundle. Given no trustworthy tag or evidence file is currently confirmed, this data source is marked unreliable rather than guessed at.
